## Historical Materialist Hook

[RESEARCH REQUIRED: Analyze the shift to set-theoretic models and the strict separation of object language and metalanguage through the lens of state-building. Utilize Alfred Tarski's The Concept of Truth in Formalized Languages to mirror the rational-legal bureaucratic optimization required by the interwar Polish state to integrate disparate legal and economic systems.]

## Core Technical Synthesis

[RESEARCH REQUIRED: Define objective mapping processes using Tarskian Semantics. Detail how to establish formal set-theoretic interpretations by defining domains of discourse and mapping relations and properties to those specific domains.]

:::{.guided-example}
<div class="guided-example-title">
Guided Example: Defining a Model
</div>
<div class="guided-example-content">
To evaluate `∀x Fx -> Gx`:

Domain: `{1, 2, 3}`
Extension of F: `{1, 2}`
Extension of G: `{1, 2, 3}`

In this model, the formula evaluates to **True**.
</div>
:::

## Problem Set

### Exercise 3.1
Explicitly define a domain with at least 4 elements. Define two predicate extensions such that the formula `∃x (Fx /\ ~Gx)` evaluates to true.
